principles.source_caption: The complete existing publication grammar supplies typed ComparisonLabels. Each actual caption occurrence must retain its normalized original raw text, native axis and own original source/glyph frame. A display may equal its legacy projection or its own original glyph box; an arbitrary shifted display cannot borrow another occurrence. Inferred role metadata never seeds scope.
principles.complete_source: Require a complete versioned native scene, strict glyph identity partition and original raw/source-box matches. Unknown or absent paint never means empty. Compound paint and nonflow words remain opaque. Raster images are retained without OCR.
principles.frame_root: Nearest native stroke-center fences enclose the two existing source role fields; the middle original fence must be unique. Three boundaries express two semantic roles, not a record/line/word budget. Source PageRules/grid hulls are insufficient when original parent paths exist separately.
principles.support: Every material needs real continuous centerline segments across its own cross support. Actual bound Down reading paths or Right baselines supply their original cross-axis point; otherwise keep the full native/opaque source envelope. Full physical primary-axis material must belong wholly to one field. No epsilon or paint hull bridges missing centerline intervals, including a1ULP gap.
principles.continuation: An earlier printed root supplies a private typed token. Require the same normalized original three-fence footprint on exactly one supported page axis, finite products, explicit finite positive original page dimensions and the appropriate original/transposed orthogonal paper basis. Display defaults cannot supply missing source extents.
principles.conservation: Whole existing Lines/Tables must have exclusive original Word owners and retain current line/cell character material. Never split a mixed-field line or change a nested table cell/merge. Missing/ambiguous identity, source paint, dimensions, geometry, independent heading or unit/outside interruption consumes the open scope. Keep table-marker numbering global and unchanged.
principles.evaluation_cost: A printed root cannot change its own already classified page. With no next page, keep the same printed provenance flag while skipping an unused future geometric certificate. An earlier active scope still validates an unlabelled final page.
principles.semantic_grammar: Actual amendment/change field captions and the existing formal publication-heading grammar remain necessary semantic evidence. No new body phrase dictionary or similarity score is introduced. Existing legacy heuristics have not all been generalized.
